subject: Render DELTA7: TLS16 draw PASS; true-MRT v4 wired, full-output compiler blocker
body:
DELTA7 render state, host-only, no commit/native/phone.

DONE:
- TLS option 16 wired through generic compile; default/variant max(vs->tls,fs->tls) stored; render sidecar in compositorPlan; compositor_submit passes thread_storage_bytes and forces v3/v4.
- Real asg_vert_lph/asg_frag_lph: TLS=16 (fragment tls16), sidecar tls16, draw commits status4 through current bridge/fake JM. Both ASan binaries PASS.
- True-MRT v4 target sidecar/encoder/compositor wiring is implemented: one v4 job, per-target token/offset/length/format/row/width/height/write mask/clear, retained targets; true Load refused; RT2-only per-RT v3 remains.
- Host path_cubic 4-slot and unbound forms, inert flag, pass/depth, v3/flat, v2, ASTC/CPU all remain green. ARM64 default+inert syntax PASS.

BLOCKER (lowering): current generic compiler refuses a full fragment pair writing outputs >DATA0: path_blit returns “Unsupported graphics output: additional colour target (use the _rt entry)”. So v4 is wired but path_blit cannot compile; no false job is emitted. Need lowering to admit a bounded multi-colour-output full pair (or an exact full-output entry) matching the MRT attachment shapes.
BLOCKER (textures/compute): n2r v4 target records carry per-target write_mask but n2r uses one s->blend record for all targets; exact per-attachment blend equations are not represented. Keep v4 disabled for unequal blend until ABI extended.
ROOT: framework_device_probe.inc still asserts maxColorAttachments=2 vs render 4.
